Name: Growling Dinos
Author: Milo49
Description:
Due to distressing short-sightedness, the original "Dinosaurs Growl" mod was removed from the Nexus. Fortunately, it was a rather simple mod and easy to recreate. Everything here is my own work, there was no copied code or files.

Requires: Content Patcher

Installation: Either extract the folder to Stardew Valley/Mods folder or install with Mod Manager of your choice.

Uninstallation: Simply delete the file, safe to uninstall at any time.


Credits to
Pathoschild for Content Patcher and SMAPI
Stardew Valley Wiki - Modding Editors for their easy-to-follow guides to modding.

﻿Start here if you want to learn how to create your own mods: https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Modder_Guide/Get_Started
